author: Dailyn Wells
title: Palo Duro high's football team shares unique family connection - NewsBreak
text:
By Dailyn Wells ,
4 hours ago
AMARILLO, Texas (KMAR/KCIT) — As Palo Duro advances in the high school football playoffs, a unique family connection is playing a major role in the Dons’ momentum this season that is carrying them into the postseason.
Head Coach Eric Mims Sr., a 2000 Palo Duro graduate, is leading a roster that includes his son, junior receiver Eric “EJ” Mims Jr., and nephews junior Julian Reese II and freshman Jordan Reese, the team’s quarterbacks. The family coaching circle also includes James Smith Jr., the offensive and defensive line coach who married into the family and is a PD graduate of 2003.
Soaring to state … again! The group says the experience has been years in the making.
“It’s like a dream come true,” quarterback Julian Reese II said. “I always wanted to play with my cousin. Now we’re doing everything we dreamed of, and I get to play with my little brother too.”
Freshman quarterback Jordan Reese delivered his first varsity touchdown in last week’s playoff win, a milestone celebrated by cousins and coaches alike.
“I finally proved that I’m just as great as my brother,” Jordan said. “It was the best feeling ever to make my family proud.”
Mims Sr. said the family dynamic builds accountability on the field. “I expect more out of these guys,” he said. “They’re leaders, and they represent our faith, our values and our name.”
Reese II has emerged as one of Palo Duro’s most improved players, taking command of the offense with stronger decision-making and accuracy.
“Sometimes the play breaks down and he has to improvise,” Mims said. “He’s earned our trust when those moments come.”
For the cousins and brothers, the time together is something they know won’t last forever. “You don’t take this for granted,” EJ said. “Not everyone gets to play football with their dad coaching and their cousins beside them.”
The Dons continue their playoff run this week, with what the family calls a shared mission built on loyalty, faith and the belief that their bond gives them an edge when it matters most.
